claim: Provide draft-mode anchor resolution: a `mix cb.resolve --file` entry point that validates and resolves bare {path, anchor, nth} stop rows against a root, with no belief collection required. CB.Codepath.resolve/3 (lib/cb/codepath.ex) dereferences belief ids today, so unregistered artifacts - draft answers, anchored positions - cannot use the one tested resolver. This is the verification gate for answer-time anchoring (b488) and the /position capture skill, and it is b488's stated escalation condition to contract grade.

evidence.detail: The gap surfaced twice in the thread: presenting the substrate position as a codepath required hand-running grep -nF with the resolver's semantics because mix cb.render.codepath only loads codepath output-targets, and b488's evidence names a draft-mode verifier as its contract-escalation condition.

Discharged 2026-06-11 (materialized t0007-t0009): CB.Anchor extracted as the belief-free core CB.Codepath and mix cb.resolve share - the belief coupling lived only in resolve/resolve_stop, so the one-tested-resolver promise holds by construction. The task accepts bare {path, anchor, nth} objects and code: URI strings interchangeably, so a position's Anchor: lines pass through verbatim; loose-anchor warnings report without failing, any unresolved or invalid row fails the gate (exit 1). Full suite green at 293 tests.

todos.action: Extract the belief-free anchor-resolution core (per-line literal matching, first-match tighten warning, out-of-range nth) from CB.Codepath into CB.Anchor, with CB.Codepath delegating

Add mix cb.resolve --file: validate and resolve a JSON array of anchor rows (path/anchor/nth objects or code: URI strings per the b043 grammar) against --root with no belief collection loaded; exit 0 only when every row resolves
Cover the resolver core and the task: CB.Anchor resolution-rule tests plus cb.resolve row parsing (mixed object/URI files, per-index error reporting) and text rendering
